children.label: Persons

children.label: Objects per Type
children.tooltip: This query focuses on the class: object
children.description: The query shows the total number of object types in the Expedit. and Expedit. 9 register volumes.

children.tooltip: This query focuses on the class: object
children.description: The query shows the number of all event types counted in the register volumes Expedit. and Expedit. 9 as the result.

children.tooltip: This query focuses on the class: event

children.tooltip: This query focuses on the class: institution
children.description: The query returns the number of all dioceses (suffragan and archdioceses combined) per sub-region in the register volumes Expedit. and Expedit. 9.

children.label: Count of Entries per Source
children.tooltip: This query focuses on the class: entry
